data.narrative:
Bedrock Robotics, a Series B robotics and manufacturing company, is valued at $1.75B post-money following $270M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of nine private robotics firms and one public comparable, with particular relevance to four same-sector peers at Series B and C stages: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Dexterity ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-subsequent-stage advancement to the $1.8B last post-money valuation, implying $3.3B. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.3B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set demonstrates heterogeneity across stage, with two Series C positions valued at the lower bound.

The triangulated analysis produces a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $3.8B (high), with a median of $2.3B. The current $1.75B valuation sits below median, positioning Bedrock within the peer range but below stage-adjusted expectations. Key uncertainties include the predictive power of the 1.9x multiplier for this specific company and heterogeneity in stage classification among peers, which may overstate or understate appropriate comparables.
